stem: Which statement correctly distinguishes pH from alkalinity?
choices: They are two names for the same measurement
pH describes acidity/basicity, while alkalinity describes acid-neutralizing capacity or buffering behavior
Alkalinity is another unit for EC
pH is used only for source water and alkalinity only for runoff
rationale: Two water sources can have similar pH but different alkalinity. Alkalinity describes neutralizing capacity and helps explain how strongly water resists pH change.
